Recover the hidden weight matrix A1 (up to permuting neurons and per-neuron
scaling) of a one-hidden-layer ReLU network

    f(x) = A2 ReLU(A1 x + b1) + b2 ,   x in R^10

using only black-box queries to forward().

------
f is a continuous piecewise-linear function. Its kink set is the union of the

    grad f(x) = sum_{j : w_j.x + b1_j > 0} a2_j w_j ,

jump across H_j is exactly  +/- a2_j w_j  -- i.e. row j of A1 up to scaling.

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/app')
import numpy as np
import forward

true = np.asarray(forward.A1, dtype=np.float64)   # (20, 10) - ground truth, used only to verify
st = np.load('/app/stolen_A1.npy')
print("true shape:", true.shape, "| stolen shape:", st.shape, "| dtype:", st.dtype)
assert st.shape == true.shape, "SHAPE MISMATCH"

k = true.shape[0]
used = set()
worst = 0.0
for j in range(k):
    rn = true[j] / np.linalg.norm(true[j])
    best_c, best_i, best_res = -2.0, -1, 2.0
    for i in range(st.shape[0]):
        s = st[i]
        if i in used:
            continue
        c = abs(float(np.dot(rn, s / np.linalg.norm(s))))
        scale = float(np.dot(true[j], s)) / float(np.dot(s, s))
        res = np.linalg.norm(true[j] - scale * s) / np.linalg.norm(true[j])
        if c > best_c:
            best_c, best_i, best_res = c, i, res
    scale = float(np.dot(true[j], st[best_i])) / float(np.dot(st[best_i], st[best_i]))
    print(f"true row {j:2d} -> stolen row {best_i:2d} | cos={best_c:.12f} | scale={scale:+.6f} | rel_resid={best_res:.3e}")
    worst = max(worst, best_res)
    assert best_i not in used, f"stolen row {best_i} used twice"
    used.
